title: Carter purge of senior CIA officers who ran legacy program

tellings.quote: you had in the CIA, just to take that as a concrete example, you had Carter essentially purge like the entire senior ranks of the CIA when he came into office. And what did those hundreds of senior CIA officers do? Many of whom were probably presiding over aspects of the legacy program in an official capacity,

plain: When Jimmy Carter took office in 1977, he is said to have purged nearly the entire senior ranks of the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, and many of those hundreds of officers may have been overseeing parts of the "legacy program", the supposed long-running secret government effort around UFOs. A researcher named Matthew Pines raises this with Michels, without naming a source, and asks what those officers went on to do, hinting that the program's knowledge may have left government with them.
